notes.text: R. Andersson is no longer killing penalties: 1% of the team’s shorthanded time in 5 games, down from 48% last season.
B. Faber has not played this season. J. Spurgeon is in his usual spot beside Q. Hughes, up from second-pair minutes last season. O. Maatta has moved into Spurgeon’s old spot beside J. Brodin.

MIN.head: Minnesota faces a real test
MIN.body: Vegas has controlled the play far better over recent games and Minnesota has home ice. Minnesota’s best way through is keeping the shots to the outside.

VGK.head: Vegas has a lot going for it
VGK.body: Vegas has controlled the play far better over recent games and Minnesota has home ice. Minnesota can make it interesting if it keeps the shots to the outside.
